decision: Calibrate native/shadow/formula on one disjoint case. Open 32 independent cases only after calibration passes. Require exact synaptic shadow, admissible native/formula floor and unchanged Task33 V/Ca/physical gates for each of six frozen Task32 models in every panel, not merely pooled. Any technical or floor failure stops model judgment; a candidate failure with admissible floor is scientific NO-GO. No checkpoint selection, retraining or threshold tuning.
scope: Full declared local inventory: 11 canonical ion channels, CaDynamics, passive membrane, four stochastic EMS synapses, autonomous V/Ca, presynaptic events and Random123 streams observed. New independent conductance panels test local generalization. Single cylindrical compartment only; excludes axial coupling, morphology, whole-cell behavior and speedup.
selection: All six Task32 checkpoints frozen before Task35; no Task35 data used for model or threshold selection.
